season.source: FS page ('closes annually on Dec. 15') + rec.gov notice ('open season from May 15th to September 30th'; 'During the off season (from 10/01 until 12/15) the USFS operates this campground'; 'Sites are open until weather prohibits access'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Pay on site; the recreation.gov listing is for scan-and-pay only.

booking.source: FS page ('Reservations are not available for Bearlodge Campground. Sites are first-come, first-served.') + rec.gov (all 8 sites 'Not Reservable', rules 'S&P Only'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: $20 May 15 - Sep 30; $15 in the October - December off-season.

fees.source: rec.gov rates (First-come, First-served Season 2027-05-15..2027-09-30: $20) + off-season notice ('Daily Fee is $15.00') + extra-vehicle notice ($5.00 per night on the second vehicle), read 2026-11-20

note: Black Hills NF campground in ponderosa pine beside WY-24, about 7 mi west of Aladdin and 25 mi from Devils Tower. Small sites for tents, trailers and small RVs. Roads are not plowed. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov (scan-and-pay listing, notices, rates, catalog) read: 8 FCFS sites, 25-ft spurs per the forest (catalog says 30-50), one pull-through, no hookups, vault toilet, water May 15-Oct 1, open May 15-Dec 15 with a USFS-run no-water off-season from Oct 1. $20 season / $15 off-season (rec.gov), $5 extra vehicle. Sites, hookups, facilities, season, booking, fees written; note cleaned. Not waterfront stands.
flags: FEE DISAGREEMENT: FS page says 'Peak Season: $18 / night'; recreation.gov rates (2026 and 2027) say $20 - rec.gov value written per the rule. Off-season $15 agrees.

MAX RIG: forest notice on rec.gov 'Parking Spur Length is 25 ft.' (written, = stored) vs catalog Max Vehicle Length 30-50 per site; catalog permits the RV (motorhome) equipment type only on site 6 (pull-through, no length) - the other seven list Tent/Trailer. A 23-ft rig is inside 25 ft either way.
BOOKING: stored FCFS stands - the rec.gov listing (10381860) is scan-and-pay only (no reservable site); rec.gov link in website is fine as a pay/info link.
PHONE: empty -> (307) 283-1361 (Bearlodge Ranger District, FS page and rec.gov facility phone). Concessionaire line (661) 702-1420.
